title: SYNTHESIS AND STRUCTURE OF COORDINATION COMPOUND OF COBALT(II) 5-SULFOSALICYLATE WITH BENZOHYDRAZIDE
abstract: The new 5-sulfosalicylato cobalt coordination compound [Co(Bhz)3]3(HSSal)3×7.5Н2О (where Bhz – benzohydrazide, HSSal2– – 5-sulfosalicylate anion) has been synthesized and studied by elemental analysis, IR and diffuse reflectance spectroscopy and single-crystal X‑ray diffraction.
